tasks.title: Nmap SNMP Scripts
tasks.description: UDP port scan and default script enumeration. SNMP runs on UDP, so it is often missed by fast TCP-only scans.

tasks.title: Brute-Force Community Strings
tasks.description: Try common/default community strings before moving to a wordlist. 'public' (read-only) and 'private' (read-write) are the most common defaults.

tasks.title: Full MIB Walk
tasks.description: Dump the entire MIB tree once you have a working community string. Look for process lists, installed software, and running services.

tasks.title: Targeted OIDs (Users, Processes, Software)
tasks.description: Query specific OIDs known to leak usernames, running processes, and installed packages.

tasks.title: Linux SNMP RCE via NET-SNMP-EXTEND-MIB
tasks.description: If a read-write community string (often 'private') is found on a misconfigured Net-SNMP daemon exposing NET-SNMP-EXTEND-MIB, arbitrary commands can be executed via extend directives.
